summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a US$25 million private placement of 5,828,342 special warrants at US$4.25 each, each automatically exercising into one common share and one five-year warrant exercisable at US$5.00. The offering is a routine capital-raising transaction under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b), with Clear Street as placement agent. Proceeds are for debt repayment, development, acquisitions, and working capital. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary equity financing, so no risk-arb angle applies.
